note: React's public surface. 'yes' entries must be exported by compat/react.ts; generate.mjs --check enforces that.

hooks.name: useState
hooks.note: returns [getter, setter]; the getter is a function, not a value

hooks.name: useEffect
hooks.note: runs immediately, tracks signal reads instead of its accepted dependency array, and invokes cleanup before rerun or unmount

hooks.name: useMemo
hooks.note: tracks reads automatically; an accepted dependency array is ignored

hooks.name: useCallback
hooks.note: identity passthrough; components run once, and an accepted dependency array is ignored

hooks.name: useRef
hooks.note: plain { current } box; a host ref receives a compiled { id } handle

hooks.name: useContext
hooks.note: returns a getter captured from the nearest compiled provider

hooks.name: useLayoutEffect
hooks.note: runs immediately as an automatically tracked effect with cleanup; its accepted dependency array is ignored and there is no separate layout commit phase

hooks.name: useImperativeHandle
hooks.note: sets a component ref once and clears it on component removal; its accepted dependency array is ignored

hooks.name: useDeferredValue
hooks.note: returns the value immediately; there is no deferred scheduler

hooks.name: useInsertionEffect
hooks.note: runs immediately as an automatically tracked effect with cleanup; its accepted dependency array is ignored and there is no insertion phase

hooks.name: useDebugValue
hooks.note: accepted as a no-op; no React DevTools runtime is shipped

hooks.name: useId
hooks.note: returns a stable process-local id; server hydration prefixes are not applicable

api.name: createElement
api.note: the JSX factory is h() in framework/jsx.ts

api.name: Fragment
api.note: named Fragment and <>...</> both return multiple roots without a wrapper

api.name: createContext
api.note: Provider children build lazily under a context stack; provider values are reactive getters

api.name: forwardRef
api.note: adapts ref props to the legacy second argument; the compiled props type must include ref and the props object retains it

api.name: memo
api.note: identity passthrough because components run once

api.name: lazy
api.note: no dynamic import in a compiled binary

api.name: startTransition
api.note: runs the callback synchronously; no concurrent scheduler is shipped

api.name: StrictMode
api.note: renders children without a wrapper; no development double-invoke pass

jsx.name: component elements
jsx.note: <Counter /> calls the function once and owns its effects until removal

jsx.name: attributes
jsx.note: string literals are set once; other expressions become reactive

jsx.name: event handlers
jsx.note: onclick -> click; any on* prop whose value is a function

jsx.name: expression children
jsx.note: auto-wrapped into a reactive binding and coerced to string

jsx.name: props on components
jsx.note: a plain object argument; children arrive as props.children

jsx.name: fragments
jsx.note: <>...</> returns multiple root nodes without a wrapper element

jsx.name: spread props
jsx.note: source-order last-write-wins; function-valued non-event host props are reactive getters

jsx.name: array / .map() children
jsx.note: an inline .map() with a key prop lowers to a keyed each()

jsx.name: element-valued expression children
jsx.note: typed El expressions are inserted directly; mixed element/primitive unions are refused

jsx.name: conditional rendering
jsx.note: ternary and && over elements lower to show(); the arms are wrapped in a span

jsx.name: reactive attributes
jsx.note: non-literal, non-handler attributes recompute when their reads change

jsx.name: ref attributes
jsx.note: host refs receive { id } and clear on removal; component refs are ordinary ref props
